papers.title: Design and Fabrication of a Precision Template for Spine Surgery Using Selective Laser Melting (SLM)
papers.abstract: In order to meet the clinical requirements of spine surgery, this paper proposes the fabrication of the customized template for spine surgery through computer-aided design. A 3D metal printing-selective laser melting (SLM) technique was employed to directly fabricate the 316L stainless steel template, and the metal template with tiny locating holes was used as an auxiliary tool to insert spinal screws inside the patient's body. To guarantee accurate fabrication of the template for cervical vertebra operation, the contact face was placed upwards to improve the joint quality between the template and the cervical vertebra. The joint surface of the printed template had a roughness of Ra = 13 ± 2 μm. After abrasive blasting, the surface roughness was Ra = 7 ± 0.5 μm. The surgical metal template was bound with the 3D-printed Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS) plastic model. The micro-hardness values determined at the cross-sections of SLM-processed samples varied from HV0.3 250 to HV0.3 280, and the measured tensile strength was in the range of 450 MPa to 560 MPa, which showed that the template had requisite strength. Finally, the metal template was clinically used in the patient's surgical operation, and the screws were inserted precisely as the result of using the auxiliary template. The geometrical parameters of the template hole (e.g., diameter and wall thickness) were optimized, and measures were taken to optimize the key geometrical units (e.g., hole units) in metal 3D printing. Compared to the traditional technology of screw insertion, the use of the surgical metal template enabled the screws to be inserted more easily and accurately during spinal surgery. However, the design of the high-quality template should fully take into account the clinical demands of surgeons, as well as the advice of the designing engineers and operating technicians.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于脊柱手术用金属导板的制造，而非多孔植入物结构或应力屏蔽，与用户方向不匹配。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks fatigue testing, and focuses on a surgical template rather than a load-bearing biomedical implant for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 为脊柱手术提供高精度辅助导板，提高螺钉植入准确性。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化（SLM）技术直接制造316L不锈钢定制化手术模板。
summary_zh.result: 模板表面粗糙度Ra=7±0.5 μm，抗拉强度450-560 MPa，临床使用显示螺钉植入精确。
summary_zh.validation: 通过临床手术验证模板的辅助效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of screw insertion in spine surgery by designing a customized metal template.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting (SLM) was used to fabricate 316L stainless steel surgical templates with optimized hole geometry.
summary_en.result: The template achieved a surface roughness of Ra=7±0.5 μm after blasting and a tensile strength of 450-560 MPa, enabling precise screw placement in clinical use.
summary_en.validation: Clinical application in a patient's surgery demonstrated the template's effectiveness for accurate screw insertion.

papers.title: A Micromechanical-based Computational Framework for Modeling the Mechanical Properties of the Metallic Parts Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting
papers.venue: OhioLink ETD Center (Ohio Library and Information Network)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM制造金属零件的力学性能建模，但未涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合相关主题。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on micromechanical modeling of SLM metal parts without any biomedical context, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发SLM金属零件力学性能的预测框架。
summary_zh.method: 基于微观力学的计算模型。
summary_zh.result: 框架能有效预测SLM零件的力学行为。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a computational framework for predicting mechanical properties of metallic parts fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A micromechanical-based approach incorporating process-induced microstructural features.
summary_en.result: The framework captures the anisotropic mechanical behavior of SLM parts.
summary_en.validation: Validated against numerical benchmarks and experimental data from literature.
